MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The portable Samsung T7 feels useful alongside my older desktop external drive because it gives me a compact way to move files without opening up my computer.",
    "The Blink bundle connects my earlier interest in door alarms with my Alexa devices, making it a plausible extension of equipment I already use.",
    "The HDMI switch relates to my Blu-ray player and Fire TV, although I would only choose it if I actually needed more connections."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV Stick repeats a need my recent 4K Max bundle already covers. The larger Echo Show interests me, but buying a Show 5 and its stand recently makes another display less timely.",
    "The enterprise hard drive and internal NVMe SSD assume an upgrade project I haven't shown an interest in. My external-drive purchase makes convenient storage a better fit than installing internal components.",
    "The headphones, five-pack of short charging cables, and separate microphone lack a clear current purpose for me. My webcam already includes a microphone, and frequent accessory purchases don't mean I need every kind of accessory."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning Alexa and Fire TV devices seems to have been taken as a reason to suggest more of the same, even when my recent purchases already meet those needs.",
    "My storage and computer-accessory purchases seem to have been stretched into an interest in internal upgrades and other equipment without a specific use."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Recent purchases matter: the Show 5 stand suggests I am equipping the display I just bought, while the Fire TV 4K Max bundle makes another streaming stick less useful right now.",
    "My history includes practical additions and replacements, such as remote batteries, adapters, and peripherals. A clear connection to equipment I own matters more than a broad resemblance to electronics I've bought.",
    "Compatibility and an unmet need matter before I choose an accessory: I would check my HDMI connections or computer support rather than assume related equipment will be useful."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in practical electronics and connected-home equipment, but often confused related products with things I currently need."
}
